texts.Invocation.Usage: Name one verb as an option, in the form -name or -name:value.

texts.Invocation.ValueUnknown: The option {0} does not accept the value {1}.
texts.Invocation.Repeat: The option {0} may be given only once.
texts.Invocation.VerbSecond: The options {0} and {1} are both verbs, and only one verb may be given.
texts.Invocation.Conflict: The options -yes and -no cannot be given together.
texts.Invocation.Help: Run llyn with one verb and any further options, each written as -name or -name:value.
texts.Invocation.HelpHelp: Lists every option, or only the options of the verb given as its value.
texts.Invocation.HelpWorkspace: Prints the {terms.workspace} folder, or moves the {terms.workspace} to the folder given as its value.
texts.Invocation.HelpFind: Lists the entries matching the text given as its value, one line each with id, headword, language and reading.
texts.Invocation.HelpColor: Colours the output with the value auto, always or never.
texts.Invocation.HelpFormat: Names the output format with the value text, tsv or json.
texts.Invocation.HelpNew: Creates and saves one entry. The value is entry, and the new entry's id is printed.
texts.Invocation.HelpDelete: Deletes the entry whose id is given as its value, after asking.
texts.Invocation.HelpHeadword: Gives the new entry the headword given as its value.
texts.Invocation.HelpLanguage: Gives the new entry the language named as its value.
texts.Invocation.HelpPronunciation: Gives the new entry the pronunciation given as its value.
texts.Invocation.HelpNote: Gives the new entry the note given as its value.
texts.Invocation.EntryMissing: No entry in this {terms.workspace} has that id.
texts.Invocation.NewEmpty: The entry holds nothing to save. Give it a headword with -headword:value.
texts.Invocation.HelpImport: Imports the markup file given as its value, after showing how each entry enters, and prints the count of imported entries.
texts.Invocation.HelpExport: Exports the entry whose id is given as its value to the file named by -to, and prints the path written.
texts.Invocation.HelpAs: Names the file format of -export with the value markup, html, markdown, docx or pdf.
